title: Input robustness: malformed cadastral portfolios
summary: A second, separable experiment. Where experiment 1 (Goias) feeds a clean 117-property list, this one feeds a deliberately messy portfolio of Mato Grosso soy properties carrying post-2020 deforestation, in three encodings, seeded with defects. It measures whether a model applies policies/INPUTS.md faithfully: dedupe, resolve points and ID-less geometries against CAR, and report the truly unresolvable rather than dropping it.

selection.note: Clean base cadasters = CAR parcels in the listed municipios that contain at least one soy field with post-2020 Hansen loss. Sampled deterministically by seed.

defects.note: Counts of injected malformed rows, each drawn from the clean sample. See INPUTS.md for the required handling of each.

extend: Add a municipio to region.municipalities, change commodity_class (e.g. 15 pasture -> cattle) or the defect counts, or add a new region block and re-run build_inputs.py. New defect kinds go in build_inputs.py's DEFECTS registry, documented in the README.
